name: claude_npc_b09_organize_storage (BC-15, BC-31, BC-37, BC-41; B09; NOT RUN)

steps._note: PREAMBLE ADDED 20261022: the owned human is now created by the scripted hire preamble (recipe F1 in SCENARIO_MANIFEST_20261022.md, section Fixtures); the "pre-hired NPC" precondition below is satisfied by it, the remaining preconditions (station, crops, containers, assignment) are still manual. CLASS: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT (two placed storage containers 5 m apart, one stack of exactly 1 item to move, owned human, Organize job: GAP-2/GAP-5). Assertions: STATE = findblocks and state captures; LOG-ONLY = expectLog "storage". NOT VERIFIABLE OFFLINE: the exact player storage block name (Data/Config blocks.xml has no cntStorage* definition; only localization keys cntStorageChest/cntStorageGeneric exist), so findblocks keeps name=storage which also matches the display name ("Storage Chest"/"Storage Box"). Requirement B09. Main-run scope: near move of one item between two named containers 5 m apart; deposit; ContainerBusy while the owner has the source open. Merge and sort are GATED (MergeCustodyReady/SortCustodyReady=false): a count>1 stack is HELD (MergeNeedsNativeStackOriginal) and storage-merge/storage-sort keys are refused by Parse. This scenario does NOT flip any flag. Naming containers and picking cells via Desk: GAP-2/GAP-5. Far move and kill/reload at each credit phase are MANUAL (GAP-4). SELECTOR REVIEW 20261022 (Codex batch 6): 1 click/expect selectors now carry an explicit window so an id or text cannot match a same-named node in another open group (e.g. HUD, backpack, vehicle windows). Item selectors (item=) are intentionally left window-less because player backpack cells and NPC cells live in different groups; resolve them from the saved uitree on the first run.

OWNED-HUMAN PREAMBLE (manifest section Fixtures, recipe F1; real game interaction, no admin bypass): spawn an unowned survivor, open the real activation radial and Talk (activateNearestEntity default command talk), pay the real Hire price with casinoCoin. Price source: Scripts/NPC/Interaction/RebirthSurvivorHirePayment.cs Price(): HireCost 500 (Config/_NPC/entityclasses.xml) + 500 x $FR_NPC_Level, discounted by perkBetterBarter / trade aura; so 3000 coins cover any fresh survivor. The hired entity class is npcRebirthPersistentSurvivorManSDCS (RebirthHiredEntityClass).
If btnHumanHire is disabled read humanHireFeedback and humanHireSlots in the saved uitree (hire capacity / level rule, B01); do not continue the scenario without an owned human.

OWNERSHIP PROOF: coins were spent (>= the 500 base cost) and the Companions window lists the human. Entity id, class and stable id for rbnpcadmin inspect are in the npcgear reply saved below (the runner cannot pass a captured id into a later step: read it from out/tests and use it by hand).

OPTIONAL fixture parts, all through the real UI: (a) station: {"setblock": {"name": "campfire","x": 16,"y": 45,"z": 993 } } plus resourceWood given and placed in it by hand (cooking scenarios use workstation_campfire fixtures); (b) NPC bag contents: Companions window, Equipment/Inventory tab, shift-click an item as in claude_ui_companion_equipment_inventory.json; (c) Desk assignment: Companions window, Assignments tab, click asgAdd. The Add dialog is code-spawned (GAP-2), so choosing job/target stays manual. These optional parts are NOT scripted here.

After the move: source stack 4, destination 1, NPC bag empty (open both containers; use expectUiItem {path,item,min,max   } with paths from uitree). Backpack unchanged during the pick. If a count>1 stack was staged, the Desk row shows the held reason, not a move.
